purpose: Independent lower-register alternatives to the first bright rainforest bird take

assets.title: Soft rainforest bird phrase
assets.role: Separate original soft deep forest-bird coo, restrained lower register
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, A single tropical forest dove quietly calls from far away, one very soft low hollow coo-woo. Deep rounded mellow bird cooing at a low register around 500 Hz, like a large wood pigeon, warm woody breathy resonance with a short gentle descending finish. A tiny quiet isolated phrase with silence before and after. No high notes, whistles, chirps, squeaks, harsh squawks or repeated song. No wind, rain, insects, frogs, speech, music or instruments. Length: 5 seconds.

assets.title: Soft rainforest bird phrase
assets.role: Separate original distant low forest dove answer, short warm hollow phrase
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, A solitary distant rainforest dove utters one small warm low pitched breathy hoo-hooo phrase, a husky hollow coo in the lower middle register around 400 Hz. Soft rounded muted wooden bird voice, slower than a chirp, very brief and quiet, gently falling away into silence between trees. Not a whistle or sharp bright bird, no high pitched chirping, not rhythmic or busy. No rain, wind, background chorus, frogs, human voice, music or instruments. Length: 5 seconds.
